anchors.description: Top sheet of the white document stack on the right desk (beside the yellow highlighter); diagonal from its top-left corner to its bottom-right corner.
anchors.visible_evidence: Flat stack of white printed sheets with four straight edges and page fanned edge visible, lying on the desk under a yellow highlighter; opposite corners of the top sheet are both visible.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Identified as ISO A4 (210x297 mm) typical of European office documents; a US Letter sheet would be ~10% shorter on the diagonal.

anchors.description: Top sheet of the white document stack near the front edge of the right desk; diagonal from its top-left corner to its bottom-right corner.
anchors.visible_evidence: Bright white stack of printed sheets lying flat on the desk with crisp top, left and right edges contrasting against the beige desk; opposite corners visible.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Identified as ISO A4 office paper; the bottom-right corner lies near a shadow, so corner localization is the main error source (a few percent).
